function.arguments: {"observation": "The cross-tabulation of `channel` vs `customer_segment` shows a strong imbalance: the email campaign was heavily targeted at `loyal` and `returning` customers, while `paid_search` has many more `new` customers. This violates the assumption of comparability between channels. Any raw difference in conversion rates between channels will be confounded by customer segment — the email group has higher-value customers who are more likely to convert regardless of channel. A simple difference in conversion rates would not isolate the campaign effect.", "implication": "The raw difference in conversion rates between email and paid_search is not a valid estimate of the campaign's effect. We must adjust for customer segment by computing the difference within each segment, or use stratification or regression to isolate the channel effect. Otherwise, we risk attributing differences in conversion to the channel when they are due to targeting."}
function.name: note_finding
